Message.Name: Channel Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Sent on a market data channel every 3 seconds, carrying the sequence number of the last market data message on the channel.

Field.Name: ApplLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the last market data message

Message.Name: Re-transmitting Message
Message.Description: Vendor Supplied System sends a re-transmission message to Market Data GateWay, which returns the re-transmission data needed followed by a re-transmission message indicating completion, or the failure reason if it fails. Market Data GateWay handles multiple requests in the order in which they arrive, so this message type is transmitted by both sides; ResendStatus and RejectText are only effective on the gateway reply.

Field.Name: ApplBegSeqNum
Field.Description: The starting sequence number, effective when ResendType=1, indicating the area of record number

Field.Name: ApplEndSeqNum
Field.Description: The ending sequence number. When ResendType=1 it indicates the area of record number. When ApplEndSeqNum=0 the Market Data GateWay sets it to the max value of this channel data record in memory on receiving the request

Field.Name: NewsID
Field.Description: Unique mark of the announcement. Empty strings indicate announcement summary, which will be sent repeatedly

Field.Name: ResendStatus
Field.Description: Re-transmitting status, only effective when the Market Data GateWay front-end processor returns to the Vendor Supplied System server

Field.Name: Reject Text
Field.Description: Only effective when the Market Data GateWay front-end processor returns to the Vendor Supplied System server. If the request is rejected the failure code is returned in this field

Message.Name: Client User Information Reporting Message
Message.Description: Vendor Supplied System reports the number of client users connected to it at the current time to the Market Data GateWay front-end processor at regular intervals. Only the Vendor Supplied System of a vendor sends this message.

Field.Name: UserNum
Field.Description: The number of client users connected to this Vendor Supplied System at the current time

Message.Name: Statistics Of Snapshot Data Channel Message
Message.Description: Each snapshot channel sends the statistic message of the snapshot channel every 15 seconds.

Field.Name: MDStreamIDs
Field.Description: One entry per market data type carried on the channel

Message.Name: Business Reject Message
Message.Description: Rejects an application layer message that satisfies the session layer rules but does not satisfy the rules of the business layer. It reports on an incorrect re-transmitted message or client user information reporting message declared by the user.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the rejected message

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: Message type of the rejected message

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Business Layer ID of the rejected message

Field.Name: BusinessRejectText
Field.Description: Explanation of rejection reasons, may include Chinese characters

Message.Name: Real Time Market Status Message
Message.Description: Released every 3 seconds, carrying the trading session state of a market and, for stock connect, the daily quota balance.

Field.Name: TradSesStartTime
Field.Description: Starting time of a trading session, reserved

Field.Name: TradSesEndTime
Field.Description: Ending time of a trading session, reserved

Field.Name: PosAmt
Field.Description: Intraday remaining amount, fixed at 0.0000 when the amount is not available

Message.Name: Real Time Status Of Security Message
Message.Description: Released every 15 seconds, carrying the security status and the state of each business switch of one security.

Field.Name: FinancialStatus
Field.Description: Security status. Each byte displays one status, at most 8 concurrently

Field.Name: Switch
Field.Description: One entry per security switch, giving its type and status

Message.Name: Announcements Message
Message.Description: Carries an announcement file. An empty NewsID indicates an announcement summary, an aggregate list of the current announcement files in text format carried in RawData as repeated BulletNum, ID, NAME, SIZE and TIME lines; under the multicast distribution protocol the summary carries no content and RawDataLength is fixed to 0.

Field.Name: NewsID
Field.Description: Unique mark of the announcement. Empty strings indicate announcement summary, which will be sent repeatedly

Field.Name: Headline
Field.Description: Announcement title, may include Chinese characters

Field.Name: RawDataFormat
Field.Description: Format of binary data, such as TXT, PDF or DOC

Field.Name: RawData
Field.Description: Binary data, its length given by the leading RawDataLength

Message.Name: Snapshot Data Of Cash Auction Message
Message.Description: Snapshot of the cash auction, carrying market data categories 010 for equities, funds and bonds and 040 for option auction. The call auction discloses the virtual matched price and quantity in the buy 1 and sell 1 levels, with the bid or offer left quantity at that price in level 2.

Field.Name: TradingPhaseCode
Field.Description: Trading phase code of the product. The No.0 digit carries the trading phase, S=start before the market opened, O=Opening call auction, T=Continuous bidding, B=Closed, C=Closing call auction, E=Closed market, H=Temporary trading halts, A=After-hours Dealing, V=Volatility interruption. The No.1 digit carries the sub phase, 0=normal status, 1=All day suspension
